content: As for methods based on feature engineering, In BIBREF1 , authors investigate pragmatic phenomena and various irony markers. In BIBREF14 , researchers leverage a combination of sentiment, distributional semantic and text surface features. Those models rely on hand-crafted features and are hard to implement.
